name: pytorch-rocm-w7900
description: Daily PyTorch/ROCm base for AMD Radeon W7900 / RDNA3 / gfx1100 family. Built from ROCm/vLLM thin CI base, installs rocm[devel,libraries] + torch + torchvision from v2-staging/gfx110X-all, runs rocm-sdk init, and exports /opt/rocm-pytorch-constraints.txt for downstream vLLM builds.
